note: CRDB Bank's Infinite Credit Card page, read on 2026-11-03: 3% per month, a minimum due of 10%, a grace period of up to 50 days (written as 50), and a limit of at most 500 million shillings (a cap, not a multiple of income, so not written). CRDB publishes no fee to hold its credit cards (its 2026 minimum disclosure prices its TemboCard debit cards only), so the card's fees are unpublished: none is charged and the player is told the game doesn't know them. Its Gold Credit Card page gives 'Interest rate 3%' with no period, a minimum due of 20% and the same grace; since the period isn't stated on its own page, the Gold card isn't written. The other banks' card terms couldn't be read (earlier rounds: DTB, Equity, I&M and KCB behind bot checks or not answering; NBC's and TCB's tariffs list no credit card).
